subject.description: Adult male, full body, clothed (knit sweater, jeans, boots), short hair and beard stubble on the scanned surface, neutral closed-mouth expression.
subject.identity_policy: Anatomical surface source only. Inez proportions come from the original references; donor colour texture is not reused; beard/brow/scalp-hair surface detail is masked.

inspection.units: metres (stature 1.847 m including boots; +Y up, +Z forward in the OBJ)
inspection.uv: Single 0-1 UV layout for the whole body; per-corner (unwelded) UVs; the head island occupies roughly 3600x2400 px of the 8K maps and the face roughly 800 px across.
inspection.normal_maps: Level_0N_Normal holds detail above subdivision level N (Level_01 strongest: eyelids, nostrils, lips, ears, hair, stubble; Level_05/06 nearly flat on the face).
inspection.micro_detail_finding: Forehead and cheeks carry little pore-scale relief in this scan; chin, jaw and neck carry stubble bumps. Pore-scale detail is therefore NOT sourced from the scan and must not be claimed as scanned.
